response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, deep technical versatility, and demonstrable leadership in AI-agent infrastructure and open-source tooling, but lacks explicit evidence of 8+ years focused on production-grade GenAI systems, cloud-based RAG architectures, or vector databases — key requirements for this staff-level GenAI role.
strengths: Proven experience with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks at re:cinq
Extensive full-stack proficiency in TypeScript, cloud tools (AWS CDK), and scalable systems
Strong track record of technical leadership, mentoring, and open-source contributions
concerns: No clear evidence of 8+ years dedicated to GenAI or production AI system deployment
Missing explicit experience with vector databases or RAG architecture implementation
Limited documentation of LLM optimization, multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph/CrewAI), or AI evaluation pipelines
